_calibration: Calibrated 2026-11-21 against main dist (version.json build v3-survival-ae77fa84ac2b) with 4 back-to-back runs of the default session
(90 s recorded, 6 s warmup, 640x360, SwiftShader) on a 4-core cloud box at load avg ~15 (other headless browsers running), so fps was 1.6-4.7.
Observed ranges -> budget (headroom):
drawCalls p50 511-580, p95 516-583, max 532-583 -> p50 680, p95 700, max 800 (~+20%; the world is random so +-12% run to run)
growth.heapMB (post-GC end - post-GC start) 0.52-0.84 MB -> 4 MB; heapMBLateHalf (post-GC mid -> end) 0.08-0.27 MB -> 2 MB
growth.domNodes (elements in the document) 2-6 -> 50; listeners 0 -> 10
growth.glObjects 83-97 (one-time: first hook throw creates rope/hook buffers+VAOs) -> 200; glObjectsLateHalf -14..0 -> 20; webglContexts 1 -> 1
longTasks: every frame is a 200-2500 ms long task on SwiftShader, so only hitches are budgeted: tasks > max(hitchMinMs, hitchFactor x median long task).
Observed hitches 0 (threshold resolved to 1067-2568 ms depending on box load) -> 2. Absolute timings (fps, scriptMsPerFrame, frameIntervalMs) are reported, never budgeted.
minFrames: observed 162-428 -> 30 (only catches a stalled render loop).
To recalibrate: run `python3.13 tests/e2e/perf_gate.py --dist dist --budget <file with only the session block> --out <dir>` 3-4 times,
take the max of each metric from <dir>/perf_gate.json and add ~20-25% (counts) or ~3-5x (heap/DOM/GL growth, which is near zero).
2026-11-21 recalibration with Math.random seeded (seed 1): 5 back-to-back runs at load ~15 gave drawCalls p50 543-552, p95 554-556, max 557-558,
triangles p95 264k-266k; 2 concurrent runs + 2 busy-loop cores (load 17-27) gave p95 557-571, max 559-571, tris p95 267k-276k, 0 hitches.
Draw/triangle budgets tightened to ~+12-19% over that (p50 620, p95 640, max 680, tris 310k): the old +20% headroom missed a deliberate
+150-mesh (+22% draws) regression. Unseeded (--no-seed) runs (observed 496-583) also fit, with less margin; the gate defaults to seed 1.
3 concurrent runs at load ~25 produced 1 hitch (a ~3 s OS-scheduling spike); hitch-only failures are therefore confirmed by one rerun (--retries).

2026-11-21 glObjectsLateHalf triage (old branches claude/raft-integration, claude/raft-diving, wip/fleet/menus, wip/fleet/placement failed at 21-31 > 20):
not leaks. Live GL objects follow scene content: on these pre-instancing builds every floating item owns its geometry (a plastic jug is ~25-31
buffers+VAOs), uploaded the first time it is in view and freed when it drifts off and respawns, so a 2-point mid->end delta moves by one
item either way (placement 240 s: 1731 -> 1762 -> 1730; integration grade run 889 -> 861 at mid -> 889; old main 1158 -> 1112 -> 1126).
240 s runs plateau (integration flat at 907 from 22 s to 265 s; menus 1980 -> 2009 by 100-290 s, the same end level as the 90 s grade run).
Gate changes: late growth = end minus the first-half HIGH-WATER mark (not the mid sample); objects still counted for a lost context (the
transient item-icon renderer, freed by forceContextLoss without delete* calls) come off the live count; budget 20 -> 40 (above one item,
~1.3 jugs). A steady leak of ~1 object/s or ~10 objects per play cycle still fails.
